occurrence_sentence: Caltech-led researchers have successfully demonstrated a quantum eraser, designed to identify and correct "erasure" errors in quantum computing systems.

"It's normally very hard to detect errors in quantum computers, because just the act of looking for errors causes more to occur," says Adam Shaw, co-lead author of the new study and a graduate student in the laboratory of [Manuel Endres](https://pma.caltech.edu/people/manuel-a-endres), a professor of physics at Caltech.
Reporting in the journal _Nature,_ a group of researchers led by Caltech is among the first to demonstrate a type of quantum eraser.
